youtube.title: "You can't just drop and run. And I know parents are busy. And believe me, I was one of those too. B
youtube.summary: "You can't just drop and run. And I know parents are busy. And believe me, I was one of those too. But you just can't." - Maree Buscke Maree Buscke warns parents not to assume today's classrooms are the same as the ones they experienced growing up. Are parents too trusting of schools, assuming they no longer need to be involved? Maree Buscke and Penny Marie (Founder of Let Kids Be Kids NZ) discuss concerns around relationship and sex education in schools, including claims that parents may not realise what content is still being taught, the use of third-party resources, transparency around teaching materials, and the importance of parents engaging with schools. 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/penny-marie-founder-of-let-kids-be-kids-nz-parents-urged-to-look-beyond-curriculum-changes #RCRMedia
